principle.id: Nilai menilai proses, bukan untung atau rugi. Proses yang benar tetap bernilai baik walaupun kena SL; proses yang salah tidak mendapat nilai tambahan karena kebetulan untung.
principle.en: The score judges the process, never the profit or loss. A sound process still scores well when it hits the SL; a poor one earns nothing extra for a lucky profit.

risk.measure: risk_pct = |entry − SL| in pips × pip value per lot (USD) × lot ÷ balance × 100

volatility_part.measure: sl_atr = |entry − SL| ÷ ATR(14) at Start (key: numbers.atr14_pips)

bonus.when: SL beyond numbers.invalidation_level (or no level given)

reasons.rule: 6 × (valid reasons chosen ÷ reasons chosen); 0 with no reason

cases.case: ran to SL, TP or the window's auto-close
manual close with a valid close reason (structure_broken, news_ahead, target_area)
manual close before the target without a valid reason (small_profit, bored)
panic close near the SL without a new signal (fear)

scenario_no_trade.rule: When decision.ideal is no_trade the whole score is decision and reasons.

pending_unfilled.rule: A pending order that never fills is scored on the decision only: decision points × 5 (out of 100); lot, SL and TP aren't scored.

mcq_complex.rule: Per option: +1 ÷ k for each right option chosen, −1 ÷ k for each wrong option chosen (k = number of right options); floor 0, max 1.

report.id: Hasil akhir berupa umpan balik per aspek (risiko, SL, TP/R:R, keputusan, manajemen posisi) dan level Learn 101 yang perlu diulang, dihitung dari soal PG yang salah per level. Tanpa peringkat dan tanpa perbandingan antar pengguna.
report.en: The result is feedback per aspect (risk, SL, TP/R:R, decision, position management) and the Learn 101 levels to revisit, from the wrong answers per level. No ranking and no comparison between users.

decision.id: Hasil referendum adalah peristiwa dengan dampak sangat besar dan hasil yang belum diketahui. Saat hasil keluar, spread bisa melebar berkali lipat dan harga bisa melompat melewati stop loss (slippage). Learn 101 Level 5 menyarankan pemula menghindar atau menunggu sampai keadaan tenang. NO TRADE di sini adalah keputusan yang sah.
decision.en: The referendum result is a very high-impact event with an unknown outcome. When results come in, spreads can widen many times over and price can jump past a stop loss (slippage). Learn 101 Level 5 advises beginners to stay out or wait until things calm down. NO TRADE is a valid decision here.

decision.id: Struktur M15 sesudah pengumuman turun (lower high dan lower low) dan arah kebijakan ECB yang melonggar berlawanan dengan The Fed yang bersiap mengetatkan. Sesuai sikap "menunggu sesudahnya" di Level 5, yang dicari adalah sell di area pullback ke resistance, bukan mengejar candle besar yang sudah lewat. Pending sell limit di area pullback paling sesuai; NO TRADE masih wajar karena volatilitas sesudah event masih tinggi.
decision.en: The M15 structure after the announcement is falling (lower highs and lower lows), and the ECB's easing runs against a Fed getting ready to tighten. In line with the "wait for afterwards" approach in Level 5, the setup is a sell on a pullback into resistance, not chasing the big candle that already went. A pending sell limit in the pullback area fits best; NO TRADE is still reasonable because volatility after the event is high.

name.en: OPEC decides not to cut output

decision.id: Struktur M15 naik (higher high dan higher low), dan keputusan OPEC menekan harga minyak sehingga CAD cenderung melemah. Buy searah tren dengan SL di bawah higher low terakhir adalah rencana yang bisa dicek. decision.en: The M15 structure is rising (higher highs and higher lows), and OPEC's decision weighs on oil, which tends to weaken CAD. A buy with the trend and an SL below the last higher low is a plan you can check. Because liquidity is thin on a US holiday, NO TRADE is acceptable too, but a big lot or a too-tight SL isn't.

Range memang bisa diperdagangkan dari batas ke batas dengan target pendek, tetapi di tengah rentang tidak ada keunggulan arah. NO TRADE adalah pilihan yang tepat.
decision.en: EMA 20 and EMA 50 are flat and crossing, price sits mid-range, and the M15 ATR is small, so the spread eats a large share of a normal move. A range can be traded edge to edge with short targets, but in the middle of it there is no directional edge. NO TRADE is the right call.

decision.id: Struktur M15 turun dan latar minyak mendukung CAD. Ujian utamanya adalah ukuran: dengan saldo $100, 0,01 lot bernilai sekitar $0,08 per pip, jadi SL struktur yang wajar masih muat dalam risiko 1–2%. Lot di atas 0,01 hampir pasti melewati batas. Jika SL strukturalmu terlalu jauh, melewatkan trade (NO TRADE) juga benar.
decision.en: The M15 structure is falling and oil supports CAD. The real test is size: on a $100 balance, 0.01 lot is worth about $0.08 per pip, so a sensible structure SL still fits within 1–2% risk. Anything above 0.01 lot almost certainly breaks the limit. If your structural SL is too far, skipping the trade (NO TRADE) is right too.

a.id: Materi drawdown menyebut batas 1–2% agar rugi beruntun tidak langsung menguras modal.
a.en: The drawdown lesson names a 1–2% cap so a losing streak doesn't drain the capital at once.

b.id: Itu memperbesar kerugian, bukan memperbaiki analisis (materi leverage dan margin).
b.en: That makes the loss bigger, it doesn't fix the analysis (leverage and margin lesson).

c.id: Tidak memasang SL disebut sebagai penyebab drawdown tinggi.
c.en: Not using an SL is listed as a cause of high drawdowns.

d.id: Ini martingale: risikonya tak terbatas dan satu rangkaian rugi bisa menghabiskan akun.
d.en: That's martingale: the risk is unlimited and one losing run can wipe out the account.

e.id: Overtrading karena ingin membalas kekalahan (revenge trading) adalah penyebab drawdown tinggi.
e.en: Overtrading to win back losses (revenge trading) is a cause of high drawdowns.

a.id: Itu stop loss. Stop out adalah penutupan paksa oleh broker saat jaminan hampir habis.
a.en: That's a stop loss. A stop out is the broker closing you out when collateral runs low.

b.id: Contoh di materi: stop out terjadi hanya setelah sekitar 14 pip.
b.en: The lesson's example: the stop out comes after only about 14 pips.

c.id: Anggap leverage sebagai kapasitas maksimum, bukan target.
c.en: Treat leverage as a maximum capacity, not a target.

d.id: Leverage hanya menurunkan jaminan yang dibutuhkan.
d.en: Leverage only lowers the collateral needed.

e.id: Memakai hampir seluruh free margin membuat satu gerakan kecil mendekati stop out.
e.en: Using almost all the free margin means one small move brings a stop out close.

a.id: Lonjakan saat rilis sering palsu; materi menyebut waktu ini sebagai ciri false breakout.
a.en: Spikes at a release are often false; the lesson lists this timing as a false-breakout sign.

b.id: Kelanjutan adalah salah satu ciri breakout valid.
b.en: Follow-through is one sign of a valid breakout.

c.id: Close di luar level dan posisi close mendekati 1 menunjukkan pembeli menguasai penutupan.
c.en: A close beyond the level and a close position near 1 show buyers in control at the close.

d.id: Melawan tren besar membuat breakout lebih rapuh.
d.en: Going against the bigger trend makes a breakout more fragile.

e.en: That's the mark of a false breakout.

a.id: Crossover terlambat dan menipu di pasar sideways.
a.en: Crossovers lag and mislead in a sideways market.

b.id: Itu cara menyiasati lag menurut materi.
b.en: That's how the lesson suggests handling lag.

c.id: Di range yang relevan adalah batasnya, bukan garis miring.
c.en: In a range, the edges matter, not sloping lines.

d.id: MA tidak menentukan titik salah; gunakan swing atau ATR.
d.en: An MA doesn't tell you where you're wrong; use swings or ATR.

e.id: MA mendatar dan dipotong bolak-balik adalah tanda sideways.
e.en: A flat MA that price crosses back and forth is a sign of a sideways market.

a.id: Arah dibaca dari dugaan suku bunga, dan tidak ada yang pasti.
a.en: Direction comes from rate expectations, and nothing is certain.

b.id: Dalam jangka pendek, inflasi di atas dugaan sering menguatkan mata uang lewat jalur suku bunga.
b.en: In the short run, above-forecast inflation often strengthens the currency through the rate channel.

c.id: Materi menyebut reaksi pertama tidak selalu benar.
c.en: The lesson says the first reaction isn't always right.

d.en: The market has already traded on the consensus.

e.id: Inflasi lebih panas dari dugaan → dugaan bunga lebih tinggi → mata uang cenderung menguat.
e.en: Hotter inflation than expected → higher rate expectations → the currency tends to firm.

a.id: The Fed bergerak bertahap dan bergantung pada data berikutnya.
a.en: The Fed moves step by step and depends on the next data.

b.id: Dolar berada di belakang (quote), jadi dolar kuat menurunkan pair.
b.en: The dollar is the quote currency, so a stronger dollar pushes the pair down.

c.id: Reaksi pertama sering berbalik saat konferensi pers berjalan.
c.en: The first reaction often reverses during the press conference.

d.id: Dolar berada di depan (base), jadi dolar kuat menaikkan pair.
d.en: The dollar is the base currency, so a stronger dollar lifts the pair.

e.id: Hawkish tak terduga → dolar cenderung menguat.
e.en: An unexpected hawkish turn → the dollar tends to firm.

b.id: Slippage justru sering terjadi saat volatilitas melonjak.
b.en: Slippage is in fact common when volatility jumps.

c.id: Contoh di materi memakai risiko 0,5% dan stop 35 pip.
c.en: The lesson's example uses 0.5% risk and a 35-pip stop.

d.id: Menghapus SL adalah kesalahan umum yang memperbesar kerugian.
d.en: Removing the SL is a common mistake that makes losses bigger.

e.id: Pada lonjakan ekstrem atau gap, eksekusi bisa jauh dari level.
e.en: In extreme spikes or gaps the fill can land far from the level.

b.id: Takut dan serakah tetap muncul; tindakanmu yang tidak dikendalikan olehnya.
b.en: Fear and greed still show up; your actions just aren't run by them.

c.id: Disiplin bukan selalu menang; kamu bisa disiplin dan tetap rugi.
c.en: Discipline isn't always winning; you can be disciplined and still lose.

d.en: This is part of the lesson's definition of discipline.

b.id: Akurasi bukan segalanya; rata-rata menang 2R membuat ekspektasi positif.
b.en: Accuracy isn't everything; a 2R average win makes the expectancy positive.

d.id: Kurang dari 30 transaksi hanya memberi kesan awal.
d.en: Fewer than 30 trades only give a first impression.

explanation.id: Forex tidak punya tempat fisik; transaksi terhubung lewat jaringan bank secara elektronik, langsung antara dua pihak.
explanation.en: Forex has no physical venue; trades run electronically through a network of banks, directly between two parties.

explanation.id: Pair ditulis BASE/QUOTE: angkanya adalah harga 1 unit base (GBP) dalam quote (USD).
explanation.en: A pair is written BASE/QUOTE: the number is the price of 1 unit of the base (GBP) in the quote (USD).

explanation.id: (147,95 − 147,20) ÷ 0,01 = 75 pip. Pair yang mengandung JPY memakai 0,01 sebagai 1 pip.
explanation.en: (147.95 − 147.20) ÷ 0.01 = 75 pips. Pairs with JPY use 0.01 as 1 pip.

explanation.id: Upper shadow menunjukkan high, lower shadow menunjukkan low periode itu.
explanation.en: The upper shadow marks the high and the lower shadow the low of the period.

explanation.id: Doji terlihat seperti garis tipis dengan tubuh kecil dan menandakan ketidakpastian.
explanation.en: A doji looks like a thin line with a tiny body and signals indecision.

explanation.id: Resistance yang tertembus dan bertahan sering menjadi support; fenomena ini disebut role reversal.
explanation.en: Broken resistance that holds often becomes support; this is called role reversal.

explanation.id: Margin = nilai posisi ÷ leverage = $80.000 ÷ 100 = $800. Margin adalah jaminan, bukan biaya.
explanation.en: Margin = position value ÷ leverage = $80,000 ÷ 100 = $800. Margin is collateral, not a cost.

explanation.id: ATR mengukur volatilitas, bukan arah. Volatilitas tinggi berarti risiko per lot lebih besar, jadi lot justru perlu lebih kecil.
explanation.en: ATR measures volatility, not direction. Higher volatility means more risk per lot, so the lot should be smaller, not bigger.

explanation.id: RSI bukan penentu mahal atau murah; menjual hanya karena RSI > 70 tanpa melihat tren adalah kesalahan paling umum.
explanation.en: RSI doesn't mean expensive or cheap; selling just because RSI > 70 without looking at the trend is the most common mistake.

explanation.id: Hawkish (elang) = condong mengetatkan; dampak umumnya mata uang cenderung menguat.
explanation.en: Hawkish = leaning toward tightening; the usual effect is a firmer currency.

explanation.id: Saat AS musim panas, 08.30 New York = 19.30 WIB; saat musim dingin menjadi 20.30 WIB.
explanation.en: During US summer time, 08:30 New York = 19:30 WIB; in winter it becomes 20:30 WIB.

explanation.id: Disposition effect muncul dari loss aversion: rugi terasa lebih berat daripada untung yang sama besar.
explanation.en: The disposition effect comes from loss aversion: a loss feels heavier than a gain of the same size.

explanation.id: Skor kepatuhan = 18 ÷ 20 = 90%. Skor ini mengukur kepatuhan, bukan untung atau rugi.
explanation.en: Compliance = 18 ÷ 20 = 90%. It measures compliance, not profit or loss.
